title: Fix native lifecycle admission, Windows persistence and risk reuse
body:
Native request handling must preserve deadlines and authority when resident processes restart, policy generations change or private files are replaced. This PR repairs those boundaries, reuses risk facts within an unchanged request, and makes strict four-platform native artifact validation part of normal CI.

The current head is [e4400844](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/commit/e44008445630aad28ccc291ec234f55a14892e6d), targeting `release/3.2`. The reviewed implementation was integrated in `ad9d9238`; `f8f190a2` corrected three conformance test paths, and the latest successor adds one immutable public-source-digest exception to `.gitleaksignore`. Every product, test and workflow file is unchanged from `f8f190a2`.

The [PRD status](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/c35d9056a14c7380b572cfee7d0262bd041bc5b4/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/20260920T152000Z-installed-validation/PRD-STATUS.md), [TODO](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/c35d9056a14c7380b572cfee7d0262bd041bc5b4/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/20260920T152000Z-installed-validation/TODO.md) and [Takeaway](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/c35d9056a14c7380b572cfee7d0262bd041bc5b4/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/20260920T152000Z-installed-validation/TAKEAWAY.md) preserve the original acceptance and the installed results observed through 15:20 UTC on 20 September. A separate [source publication update](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/c35d9056a14c7380b572cfee7d0262bd041bc5b4/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/20260920T152000Z-installed-validation/PUBLICATION-UPDATE.md) records the subsequent scanner-only change. The checkpoint preserves all earlier evidence, 144 original task objects and 119 catalog entries; it does not promote archived labels into current acceptance.

- Resident I/O retains deadline and non-replay guarantees. A publisher can accept the first generation in a completely observed empty retained namespace; unknown scans, changed identities, live-generation changes and post-ACK mutation still refuse readiness.
- Windows private readers preserve audited descriptor and Unicode CRT behavior. Extended atomic rename requires positive platform and exact-source-handle capability checks before mutation. The original operation is selected before mutation when unsupported; a native attempt never retries or falls back.
- Request-local risk facts are reused only while exact inputs, catalog, authority and implementation bindings remain valid. Effectful callbacks and approval continuation retain revalidation boundaries and the final 5 ms fence.
- Native contracts distinguish current authority, availability, distribution and rollback. Normal CI verifies all four native platform archives and pure-wheel equality through the strict validator without a Windows waiver. Windows XML is retained separately, and publisher/manager regressions are selected on the required platforms.
- Current conformance binding preserves historical auth vectors and checks only the exact reviewed Windows reader insertion, its location and provider hashes. Additional, relocated or independently repinned changes are rejected.

| Verified scope | Actual result | Practical limit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Combined implementation source | 108 passed, 17 Windows-only skips; Ruff/format/diff pass; full source types 0 errors/30,179 warnings | Only three workflow selectors followed that source preflight. |
| Conformance correction | 29 binding controls; affected cohort 74 passed/29 explicit platform or unavailable-binary skips; types 0 errors | Test-only successor; historical vectors unchanged. |
| Risk reuse | Final isolated Python 3.14 lane 347 passed, no skips, including 13 mandatory positives and 49 approval cases | Original supported interpreter results and producer-specific skips remain source-bound. |
| Fresh normal Windows | 149 passed/3 POSIX skips; 53 mandatory cases, 90 child frames, 18 Unicode pairs, original manager selector and 40 storage/namespace cases; 21 installed native decisions/receipts | Separate all-evidence journal permission event remains; the resident 5-test suite has no retained binary hash. |
| Fresh normal Mac ARM and Intel | Each 24 native controls, 21 default-auto decisions/receipts and all 14 ordinary smoke gates pass | c16 p99 423.803/735.212 ms exceeds the original 200 ms target. |
| Corrected installed Mac ARM phase diagnostic | All 88 parent/daemon joins complete; 84 allow/4 deny; no capture loss; exact source/runtime and contained cleanup | Every original route latency ceiling still fails; observer overhead is not independently subtractable. |
| Original installed 100-workspace lifecycle diagnostic | Expiry passes 190.295685 ms; restart passes 367.173894 ms with exact workspace-99 request/receipt/drain checks | Lost hints and key rotation fail current authenticated ACK; first admission fails initial setup. Original exit 1, built-in instrumentation and incomplete full matrix remain. |

[Normal native run 35517566371](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35517566371) completed successfully at `f8f190a2`: all four native platforms and the strict artifact collector passed. Its actual test-merge build `753850955c33eb15f992d1fe7ca375dd26c3a070` has the same source tree. The original Linux soak records 100,000 requests/responses and 250,000 receipts, zero reported errors or health failures, a stable PID and 3.3154% RSS growth. These ordinary soak and artifact gates do not establish the original mixed-load, full-process or launcher performance requirements. The coherent artifact set is now available for the prepared full six-file rehearsal; signing/frozen provenance and live installed version transitions remain separate.

The previous parent Linux soak was cancelled when the conformance push triggered the existing concurrency rule. That incomplete result remains retained. The latest scanner correction was pushed only after a fresh API read confirmed the entire f8 native workflow was terminal, so it did not cancel that completed cohort.

The scanner finding is exactly the SHA-256 of the public 9,539-byte auth source in the new fixture. Six scope controls prove that other commits, paths and values still trigger detection; original and candidate full-range scans cover the same 1,352 commits/69,558,377 bytes. The exact one-fingerprint exception removes that finding only. [New-head hosted Security Gates](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35519707598) now pass: Gitleaks scans 1,353 commits with no findings. Broader current-head CI is still running.

Kilo's prior output-limit failure is an external review-app result, not an Actions source-test failure; it is not required by the visible applicable ruleset, and the inaccessible classic-protection API remains an access limit. The f8 Sonar quality gate passed with three open tuple-shape code smells. Their variable-length tagged fingerprints are compared as whole values; source review found no fixed-arity consumer or authority defect. These statuses do not supply eligible GitHub approval.

Original qualification remains incomplete. Ordinary 1,000 ms concurrency smoke and 50% long-soak RSS gates do not replace the original 200 ms c16 and 12% mixed RSS requirements. Full matched-host populations, supported registered approval/alias/source-reference routes, child cost attribution, mixed receipt/process resources, accepted-change-to-first-decision freshness, six-file signed/frozen artifacts, update/downgrade/rollback and concrete canary evidence remain required. The original [task acceptance and dependencies](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/c35d9056a14c7380b572cfee7d0262bd041bc5b4/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/20260920T152000Z-installed-validation/task-status-overlay.json) are unchanged. Eligible independent CODEOWNER/last-push review of the actual final head remains a repository gate.
